description.value: Oakberry is a Brazilian-origin açaí bowl chain with a Vancouver outpost on Water Street in Gastown. The format is entirely takeout-focused — no indoor or outdoor seating — making it a quick stop for a customizable, fruit-forward bowl. The brand is operated in Canada by Snowbank Brands and also offers a mobile OAKVAN catering unit for events in Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 25m; rack (2 spaces) at 29m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes, indoor_seating=no, outdoor_seating=no, and no drive-through. The website is live and matches the OSM URL (oakberrycanada.ca, operated by Snowbank Brands), confirming the business is open; the catering page references 'Currently available in Vancouver only,' consistent with a Vancouver location. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or most other amenities.
concerns: Website does not display the store phone number (+1-604-336-0947) or the specific Water Street address, so neither could be confirmed against OSM.
No seating available (indoor_seating=no, outdoor_seating=no per OSM); cyclists have no place to sit on-site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food business on a busy Gastown street; takeout-only format suits passing cyclists well.

wow_evidence: Brazilian-origin açaí bowl chain... operated in Canada by Snowbank Brands
